PlayerBoard.battlefield: {name}'s battlefield, {count, plural, one {# card} other {# cards}}
PlayerBoard.stack: {name}'s stack, {count, plural, one {# card} other {# cards}}
PlayerBoard.hand: {name}'s hand, {count, plural, one {# card} other {# cards}}
PlayerBoard.cardKeys: Arrow keys move between cards and select; Shift and an arrow extends the selection, Ctrl and an arrow moves without selecting, and Space marks or unmarks a card. Enter plays or taps, M moves to a zone and position you choose, Shift+F10 opens the card menu, hold Z to zoom. Tab is Next phase; F6 moves on to the next control.
